description: Support escalation triage environment. tools.name: get_review_flagged_tickets
tools.description: Retrieve the support tickets currently tagged review_flagged, including subject, requester, org, current tier, tags, priority, and agent notes.

tools.name: lookup_escalation_history
tools.description: Look up prior escalation history for the flagged tickets from spreadsheet ss_escalation, worksheet ws_history.

tools.name: read_escalation_config
tools.description: Read the escalation configuration including the Batch_Reference, tier ladder, and readiness rules from worksheet ws_config.

tools.name: assess_escalation_readiness
tools.object: flagged tickets against readiness rules and escalation history
tools.description: Evaluate each flagged ticket against the config readiness rules and prior escalation history to determine which are ready to advance to the next tier.

tools.name: draft_escalation_batch_summary
tools.description: Compile a draft escalation batch summary with per-ticket recommendations and the Batch_Reference, staged for the user's review and approval.

tools.name: advance_ticket_tier
tools.object: Zendesk ticket tier field and escalation comment
tools.description: Advance a ticket to the next escalation tier in Zendesk and add the escalation comment to the ticket.

tools.name: remove_review_tags_from_ticket
tools.description: Remove the review_flagged tag from a ticket in Zendesk to mark it as processed.

tools.name: append_escalation_log_row
tools.description: Append a row to the escalation tracker worksheet ws_log recording the tier change and timestamp.

tools.name: post_escalation_summary_to_channel
tools.description: Post the escalation batch summary to the #support-escalations Slack channel.

tools.name: lookup_ticket_requester
tools.description: Look up the requester profile for a ticket, including org, plan, and contact details.

tools.name: read_escalation_policy_manual
tools.description: Read the support escalation policy manual for tier-advancement rules and approval requirements.

tools.name: list_support_channels
tools.description: List the support team's Slack channels and their owners for reference.
